definitions.gloss: well-connected, having a wide circle of acquaintances
definitions.explanation: Describes someone who knows many people in various fields or circles and has an extensive network.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{顔|かお}が{広|ひろ}い。
{顔|かお}が{広|ひろ}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}して→紹介する：05641_shoukaisuru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I was introduced by someone with many connections.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{顔|かお}が{広|ひろ}くない⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{務|つと}まらない→務まる：10413_tsutomaru⟧。
examples.english: You can't serve as a politician without being well-connected.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{顔|かお}が{広|ひろ}い⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{困|こま}った→困る：00861_komaru⟧⟦とき→とき：10077_toki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たよ}りになる→頼りになる：20294_tayorininaru⟧。
examples.english: The president is well-connected, so you can count on him when you're in trouble.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{顔|かお}が{広|ひろ}くて、⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{知|し}り{合|あ}い→知り合い：03253_shiriai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけられる→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: She's so well-connected that she has acquaintances everywhere. When I walk with her, people greet her again and again.

notes:
STRUCTURE: ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ (face) + ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ + ⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧ (wide). Literally 'one's face is wide' - meaning one's face is known widely.

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{顔|かお}が{利|き}く→顔が利く：noentry⟧ (to have influence, pull) - using connections
- ⟦{人脈|じんみゃく}→人脈：18253_jinmyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧ (to have a wide network) - more formal
- ⟦{知|し}り{合|あ}い→知り合い：03253_shiriai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧ (to have many acquaintances) - simpler expression

NUANCE: Implies not just knowing many people casually, but having meaningful connections that can be useful in business or social situations.

CULTURAL NOTE: In Japanese society, personal connections (⟦{人脈|じんみゃく}→人脈：18253_jinmyaku⟧) are highly valued for getting things done. Being {顔|かお}が{広|ひろ}い is seen as a valuable social asset.
